role: Domain 2 R2-measure (zombie competition and zombie mimics: prevalence and cost in realistic fields)

prevalence.method: agent2/night/scratch/B062/scan.mjs: byte search of every warrior in field2025 (75 teams), 2024 live (42), 2024 final (12), 2023 final (42), counters, peers for zom20a windows, the zom20b/d tail, and INT 87h users that load zombie bytes as immediates.
prevalence.zom20aMimics_E2F281C3: 2025 only: HRZ_Grindo_Holics (G1+33h, G2+45h, G2+1C5h, all in dead code) and GSA_callfart (cf1+46h, cf2+04h). None in 2024 live/final, 2023 final, counters or peers (those pools use other zombies anyway).
prevalence.otherZom20aCopies: AVI_AnotherBitInTheWall has only 41 93 E2 F2 (a decoy for the Fishandpoultry2/HDS_YOY2 pattern, not for rev0). Grindo also carries 3 copies of E2 00 81 C3 (G1+D7h, G2+37h, G2+1BEh), so moving to the only other live-loop-unique window does not avoid it.
prevalence.zom20aInt87Competitors: AVI_Fishandpoultry2 and HDS_YOY2 (41 93 E2 F2 -> FF 26 xx). GSA_VanLavan / F24_TOM_R_JS load 81 C3 but search 81 C3 74 01 (not a zombie). callfart's INT 87h searches 89 C6 81 C6 (not a zombie).
prevalence.bdCompetitors: EB F9 CC CC INT 87h searchers in 2025: HRZ_MOV_AX_WIN1/2, HRZ_Registered_Winners1/2 (hook [9769h], stolen by rev0 A), HRZ_LowKey_WBB1, GGN_OpcodeHunter2, TOM_anonymous1/2. Address-based b/d grabs via the [x612h] cells + xlat: Grindo2 ([2612h]) and callfart2 ([3612h]). All counters/peers also search EB F9 CC CC.
prevalence.exposure: 2 of 75 teams in the 2025 field carry rev0-relevant decoys; a random 3-opponent cohort contains one with p = 1 - (72*71)/(75*74) = 0.079 (screen S: 2 of 25 2025 cohorts).

recommendation: Nothing to promote (both candidates are ablations used only for measurement). Zombie mimics are a real but small realistic weakness: they cost rev0 about 0.10-0.13 points per battle when Grindo or callfart is in the cohort, about 0.009 points/battle on a 2025-like field, and 0 on the 2024/2023 pools. A pattern change cannot fix it (Grindo copies every usable window). The only route would be location-based capture (decode zom20b/d's [x612h] cells like Grindo2/callfart2, or a dynamic check), worth at most about +0.01 on 2025 fields. Give it low priority compared with the movsw/lattice threats. The capture itself is worth 0.16-0.19 per battle in the clean 2025 field, so any edit that delays or weakens A's INT 87h or the B chain is costly.
